name: Corrupted Love
source:
This is a story that revolves around the events of Max's life. Max took a gamble on a crypto currency and it paid off, he now never has to worry about money again. With the money, he bought all the things he has always wanted.

In his youth he moved from one lady to the next, but never had the urge to settle down and start a family. As time went by he always felt like there was something missing from his life..

[From Itch.io]
translation:
这是一个围绕麦克斯生活事件展开的故事。Max赌了一把加密货币，并得到了回报，他现在再也不用为钱发愁了。他用这些钱买了所有他一直想要的东西。

年轻时，他从一位女士换到另一位女士，但从未有过安定下来建立家庭的冲动。随着时间的流逝，他总觉得自己的生活缺少了一些东西。

[来自Itch.io]
